description: 조합형 생성용 인벤토리. 코드가 무작위로 뽑아 비트 슬롯을 채우고, 모델은 문장만 쓴다. 모든 항목은 3~7세가 아는 것, 무서운 것 없음.

plantedObjects.en: a piece of a paper piñata
a carrot for a snowman nose
an ember pot (carried by an adult)
a beach ball (bounces high on the Moon)

obstacleTypes.en: a flower field buzzing with bees
the tempting smell of baking bread
a gate that opens when you count
a gate that opens only to a song
stepping stones in a color order
a bridge in a gusty wind

twistTypes.en: the mystery turns out to be a familiar object
twistTypes.hint: 처음에 심은 물건이 소리·그림자·움직임의 주인이었다

twistTypes.en: the helper and the helped swap roles
twistTypes.hint: 도움을 받으러 갔는데 오히려 도와주게 된다

twistTypes.en: the smallest creature solves it
twistTypes.hint: 힘센 것들이 다 실패한 일을 개미·달팽이가 해낸다

twistTypes.en: the sound has an unexpected owner
twistTypes.hint: 무서운 줄 알았던 소리의 주인이 작고 귀여운 존재

twistTypes.en: it was right here all along
twistTypes.hint: 주머니·모자 위·등 뒤에 있었다

twistTypes.en: a mistake becomes the solution
twistTypes.hint: 넘어지거나 떨어뜨린 것이 문제를 풀어 준다

twistTypes.en: the other one wanted the same thing
twistTypes.hint: 경쟁하던 둘이 같은 목표였음을 안다

twistTypes.en: a friend was quietly watching
twistTypes.hint: 내내 따라오던 작은 생물이 마지막에 나타난다

twistTypes.en: the big scary shape was a small thing's shadow
twistTypes.hint: 큰 것인 줄 알았던 게 작은 친구의 그림자였다

twistTypes.en: the answering voice was an echo
twistTypes.hint: 대답하던 목소리는 유하 자신의 메아리였다

twistTypes.en: it was a reflection in a mirror or water
twistTypes.hint: 따라 하던 아이는 거울·물에 비친 유하였다

twistTypes.en: small friends did it while everyone slept
twistTypes.hint: 밤새 개미·새들이 조금씩 해 두었다

twistTypes.en: it was in the opposite direction all along
twistTypes.hint: 앞으로만 갔는데 뒤돌아보니 바로 뒤에 있었다

twistTypes.en: the lost thing had grown
twistTypes.hint: 심은 씨앗·작은 것이 자라서 몰라봤다

twistTypes.en: the missing one was Yuha
twistTypes.hint: 숫자가 모자란 줄 알았는데 세는 사람을 빼먹었다

twistTypes.en: the weather moved it
twistTypes.hint: 바람이 날리거나 물에 떠내려가 옆 장소에 있었다

twistTypes.en: there were two all along
twistTypes.hint: 하나인 줄 알았던 것이 쌍둥이·두 개였다

twistTypes.en: it came to ask for help
twistTypes.hint: 무서워 보이던 존재가 사실 도움을 청하러 왔다

twistTypes.en: the follower was Yuha's own sound
twistTypes.hint: 발소리가 따라오는 줄 알았는데 유하 가방 소리였다

twistTypes.en: it wasn't lost, it was a gift
twistTypes.hint: 없어진 물건은 친구가 꾸며서 돌려주려던 것

twistTypes.en: it appears when you look upside down
twistTypes.hint: 물구나무·거울·물에 비춰 보니 그제야 보였다

twistTypes.en: count the other way
twistTypes.hint: 앞에서 세면 없는데 뒤에서 세면 있었다

twistTypes.en: too close to notice
twistTypes.hint: 머리 위·등 뒤·손 안처럼 너무 가까이 있었다

twistTypes.en: the noise was music
twistTypes.hint: 괴상한 소리는 친구가 연습하던 노래였다

twistTypes.en: it was waiting for Yuha
twistTypes.hint: 찾아다닌 것이 처음 자리에서 유하를 기다리고 있었다

twistTypes.en: only something small can fit
twistTypes.hint: 큰 친구들은 못 들어가고 가장 작은 친구가 해결

twistTypes.en: the wind carried the sound
twistTypes.hint: 소리의 주인은 멀리 있었고 바람이 가까이 들리게 했다

twistTypes.en: it grew while everyone slept
twistTypes.hint: 밤새 씨앗·눈·빵이 자라거나 부풀었다

twistTypes.en: the swapped thing was a shoe
twistTypes.hint: 이상한 발자국은 친구와 신발이 바뀐 탓이었다

twistTypes.en: the helper was tiny
twistTypes.hint: 큰 도움을 준 건 개미·달팽이 같은 작은 친구

creatures.en: a sparrow in the rooftop garden
a star fish that swims in air
an ant as big as a dog
a bird painted with one dot
a cat drawn in one line
a butterfly in the light garden
a turtle in the glass aquarium
an owl in the great tree
a little wooden train called Chik-chik

home.en: next to the shoe cabinet by the door
the little table beside the bed

forest.en: in front of the big mossy rock
the stepping stones across the stream

sea.en: a line of shells on the sand
the steps of the sea wall

dino_land.en: at the foot of the twin-peaked volcano
stepping stones on the turquoise lake
the lookout in the enormous tree

humorBeats.en: a sneeze blows the hat off
something gets stuck on a tail and drags along
the hat goes on upside down
one foot plops into a puddle
an echo answers back
a blade of grass tickles a nose
the boots are on the wrong feet
a little toot escapes
says hello to his own shadow
the hiccups will not stop
a bubble lands on a nose
the hat rolls away in the wind
walks backward and plops down
copies every move the friend makes
hides, but the tail sticks out
a shoe comes off and only the sock is left
pretends the yawn got stuck open
asks the echo its name
waves at the reflection
a butterfly flies out of the hat
the hiccups keep the beat of a song
a handstand spills pebbles from a pocket

humorBeats.ko: 동물 친구가 유하 춤을 똑같이 따라 춘다
humorBeats.en: the animal copies Yuha's dance exactly
the umbrella opens upside down and becomes a basket
the wind stands the hair straight up
the footprints go backwards

humorBeats.ko: 과일 씨가 튀어 친구 코에 맞는다
humorBeats.en: a fruit seed pops onto a friend's nose
a sneeze blows away all the dandelion fluff

humorBeats.ko: 꽃 냄새를 맡다 벌과 눈이 마주친다
humorBeats.en: sniffs a flower and meets a bee eye to eye

humorBeats.ko: 큰 잎을 우산으로 썼는데 구멍이 있다
humorBeats.en: the leaf umbrella has a hole in it
puts the mittens on the feet

humorBeats.ko: 동물 울음을 흉내 냈는데 다른 동물이 대답한다
humorBeats.en: imitates one animal and a different one answers
tries to step on a shadow and spins in place

humorBeats.ko: 조개껍데기를 귀에 대니 친구 목소리가 난다
humorBeats.en: a seashell seems to talk — the friend is whispering behind

humorBeats.ko: 눈사람에게 목도리를 둘러 주고 자기가 춥다고 한다
humorBeats.en: gives the snowman the scarf, then shivers
pats the tummy and it sounds like a drum
a butterfly lands on the nose and the eyes cross
pretends to sleep and really snores

humorBeats.ko: 물수제비 돌이 한 번도 안 튀고 퐁 빠진다
humorBeats.en: the skipping stone just goes plop

humorBeats.ko: 친구 흉내를 내다 둘이 똑같은 자세로 멈춘다
humorBeats.en: both freeze in the same silly pose
the 'hat' turns out to be a bucket

humorBeats.ko: 박수를 치자 새들이 똑같이 날개를 친다
humorBeats.en: claps, and the birds clap their wings

humorBeats.ko: 친구 이름을 불렀는데 메아리가 먼저 대답한다
humorBeats.en: calls a name and the echo answers first
the shadow heads home first
an acorn rolls out of a shoe
a sneeze blows out a dandelion instead of a candle

humorBeats.ko: 우산을 썼는데 비가 우산 안에서만 온다
humorBeats.en: it rains only inside the umbrella

humorBeats.ko: 물고기한테 손을 흔들자 물고기가 꼬리를 흔든다
humorBeats.en: waves at a fish and it waves its tail
yesterday's snack turns up in a pocket

humorBeats.ko: 동물이 유하 모자를 쓰고 유하는 동물 흉내를 낸다
humorBeats.en: the animal wears the hat, Yuha plays the animal

humorBeats.ko: 뒤로 걷다가 거울 속 자신과 부딪힌다
humorBeats.en: walks backward into the mirror
burps inside a bubble
puts one mitten on a tail

humorBeats.ko: 노래를 부르다 음이 올라가서 끼익 한다
humorBeats.en: the song squeaks on the high note
catches raindrops on the tongue and gets one on the nose
mistakes a tummy rumble for thunder
shines the flashlight on his own face and jumps

humorBeats.ko: 새가 머리 위에 앉아 둥지인 줄 안다
humorBeats.en: a bird sits on his head thinking it's a nest
wears a sock as a headband

humorBeats.ko: 똑같이 생긴 돌 두 개를 서로 바꿔 놓고 다르다고 우긴다
humorBeats.en: swaps two identical stones and insists they're different
the friend sleep-talks about snacks

humorBeats.ko: 개미 줄을 따라가다 자기 신발로 돌아온다
humorBeats.en: follows the ant line back to his own shoe

humorBeats.ko: 바람에 모자가 날아가 염소 머리에 앉는다
humorBeats.en: the hat blows onto a goat
the animal yawns and Yuha yawns too

humorBeats.ko: 물웅덩이 속 하늘을 보고 떨어질까 봐 조심조심 걷는다
humorBeats.en: walks carefully around the sky in a puddle

humorBeats.ko: 휘파람을 불려다 침이 튀어 친구가 비 오는 줄 안다
humorBeats.en: tries to whistle, sprays spit, the friend thinks it's raining
tries to be silent and the tummy rumbles
races a snail and loses

humorBeats.ko: 보자기를 망토로 둘렀는데 뒤로 끌려 넘어진다
humorBeats.en: wears a cloth as a cape and trips on it
balances a spoon on his nose while walking

humorBeats.ko: 거울에 대고 혀를 내밀었는데 거울도 혀를 내민다
humorBeats.en: sticks out a tongue and the mirror does too
opens wide for a cloud thinking it's cotton candy

humorBeats.ko: 곰 인형에게 먼저 잘 자라고 인사한다
humorBeats.en: says goodnight to the teddy first

humorBeats.ko: 딸꾹질 할 때마다 비눗방울이 하나씩 나온다
humorBeats.en: a bubble comes out with every hiccup

humorBeats.ko: 뛰다가 신발 두 짝이 서로 바뀐다
humorBeats.en: the shoes end up on the wrong feet mid-run

humorBeats.ko: 눈 감고 숫자 세다 열에서 다시 하나로 간다
humorBeats.en: counts to ten with eyes shut and starts over

humorBeats.ko: 친구가 숨은 곳에서 코 고는 소리가 난다
humorBeats.en: snoring gives away the hiding spot

humorBeats.ko: 모자 속에 아까 먹던 딸기가 있다
humorBeats.en: a half-eaten strawberry is in the hat

humorBeats.ko: 오리가 유하 줄을 서서 같이 기다린다
humorBeats.en: a duck joins the line behind Yuha
offers a snack to a shadow

humorBeats.ko: 풍선을 놓쳐서 풍선이 먼저 집에 도착한다
humorBeats.en: the balloon gets home first

humorBeats.ko: 귀에 조개를 대고 바다 소리인 줄 알았는데 친구 방귀 소리
humorBeats.en: the 'sea' in the shell was a toot
the rabbit eats the snowman's nose
asks 'who's there?' and it's the backpack strap
the dog answers for Yuha
shows off a milk mustache

humorBeats.ko: 낙엽 더미에 뛰어들었는데 낙엽이 전부 날아가 버린다
humorBeats.en: jumps into the leaf pile and all the leaves fly away
blows the whistle backwards and gets a pfft

humorBeats.ko: 동물 등에 올라탔는데 동물이 그대로 눕는다
humorBeats.en: climbs on the animal's back and it lies down

humorBeats.ko: '하나, 둘, 셋'에 모두 다른 방향으로 뛴다
humorBeats.en: on 'three' everyone runs a different way
waves, and a pinwheel spins instead
the seeker falls asleep first

humorBeats.ko: 씨앗을 심고 1분 뒤에 꽃이 안 핀다고 묻는다
humorBeats.en: plants a seed and asks why no flower after one minute

humorBeats.ko: 물수제비를 던졌는데 개구리가 받아 다시 던진다
humorBeats.en: a frog catches the skipping stone and throws it back
tries to board a paper boat and flattens it
the wool hat slides over the eyes
follows tracks that turn out to be his own
shouts 'Mom!' and a goat answers 'Maa!'
stands on tiptoe and so does everyone

humorBeats.ko: 종을 흔들자 양 떼가 전부 돌아본다
humorBeats.en: rings a bell and the whole flock turns

forbiddenKeywordsNote: 한 음절 키워드는 쓰지 않는다(예: '피'는 '피리'에, '죽'은 '죽순'에 걸린다). 반드시 두 음절 이상 또는 조사 포함 형태로.

refrainTemplates.text: 한 걸음, 두 걸음, 세 걸음.
하나 더, 하나 더, 하나 더.

variantRules.description: 코드가 조합해 물건·생물을 늘린다. objectColors×colorable 물건, objectSizes×모든 물건, creatureTraits×모든 생물. expandInventory()가 적용.
